name: klad
title: klad (2D art painted through its command line)
applies: A project whose 2D art (textures, sprites, icons) is painted with klad: .klad drawings in the folder named in conventions/klad/settings.sh, each exported to a PNG file that is committed next to the drawing's source.

rules.rule: Every drawing opens and exports without an error.
Every committed picture is exactly what its drawing exports to now, and no drawing is missing its picture.
enforced_by: klad export (the same pixels on every machine)

rules.rule: Binary files are committed only in the folders the owner names; everywhere else they are refused.
enforced_by: the diff policy of the Maestro service (policy.binary_paths)
the secret scan of the Maestro service

rules.rule: The agent cannot change these rules, the scripts that check them, the skill, or the CI workflows.
enforced_by: the diff policy of the Maestro service (protected paths)

image:
RUN set -eu; \
    apt-get update; \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends build-essential pkg-config python3; \
    case "$TARGETARCH" in amd64) t=x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu ;; arm64) t=aarch64-unknown-linux-gnu ;; *) echo "no Rust for $TARGETARCH" >&2; exit 1 ;; esac; \
    export RUSTUP_HOME=/tmp/rustup CARGO_HOME=/tmp/cargo; \
    cd /tmp; \
    curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -o rustup-init "https://static.rust-lang.org/rustup/dist/$t/rustup-init"; \
    curl -fsSL --proto '=https' --tlsv1.2 -o rustup-init.sha256 "https://static.rust-lang.org/rustup/dist/$t/rustup-init.sha256"; \
    echo "$(cut -d ' ' -f 1 rustup-init.sha256)  rustup-init" | sha256sum -c -; \
    chmod +x rustup-init; \
    ./rustup-init -y --profile minimal --no-modify-path; \
    git clone --quiet --depth 1 --branch v0.4.0 https://github.com/klad-app/klad /tmp/klad; \
    cd /tmp/klad; \
    test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = 971a89b671ebbed0f806e2969f5da1a4c6735abb; \
    /tmp/cargo/bin/cargo build --release --locked --no-default-features -p klad-cli; \
    install -s target/release/klad /usr/local/bin/klad; \
    cd /; \
    rm -rf /tmp/klad /tmp/rustup /tmp/cargo /tmp/rustup-init /tmp/rustup-init.sha256; \
    apt-get purge -y build-essential pkg-config; \
    apt-get autoremove -y; \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*
image_note: klad v0.4.0, built from its source on this machine (a few minutes, once). klad is source-available: the build is for your own use; do not publish the image
after_apply: Set KLAD_SOURCE and KLAD_OUTPUT in conventions/klad/settings.sh to your folders.
Let the agent commit the pictures: in the settings file, policy.binary_paths: ["<KLAD_OUTPUT>/**"]. Everywhere else binary files stay refused.
For pictures on the pull request: screenshots.command: sh conventions/klad/previews.sh
